label: Research briefing
description: A short slide video of a research report: the summary, the key figures, the steps and where the facts come from.
subject: research
brief_template: This video briefs {name} on {gap}: what it is, the key figures, the steps, and where the facts come from.
rules: Use only facts in the research report (report.json and report.md). Every scene cites the report and the source URL behind each fact.
Open with a title scene that says the topic and the report's "as of" date.
Show the key figures as stat scenes, the steps as a timeline, comparisons as a comparison or matrix, and the report's numbers as a chart only when it has three or more.
Say plainly when the report says a rule or number changes often, and what it couldn't confirm.
General information only: never tell the viewer what to do about their own visa, legal, tax or money situation.
Close with a recap-card that names the main official sources and the "as of" date.
